The '''Zethusian plains''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamori/Legends|Kamori]]. The [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Hyra]], [[Jandal]] and [[Kimora City]] were situated on the Zethusian plains. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a series of [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] damaged the cities and caused thousands of [[Death/Legends|deaths]].
